name: Primary bedroom · built-in joinery
description: L-shaped primary-bedroom wardrobes with a blind corner, double hanging, internal drawers and a recessed walnut vanity. Open the doors to inspect the storage; use Person to check scale. Visualization only.

evidence.source: Furniture drawing, PDF page 1 · B elevations and plan; user sign-off
evidence.note: Both B elevations give 425 cm overall; the plan chain reads 427 cm. The user approved 4250 mm as the governing width for the visualization, treating 427 cm as the site dimension.

evidence.source: Furniture drawing, PDF page 1 · B exterior right and left callouts
evidence.note: Right overall callout is 274 cm; left exterior uses 267 cm plus 6 cm plinth. Draft uses 2740 mm max and a stepped 2730 mm left run; verify ceiling/drop on site.

evidence.source: Furniture drawing, PDF page 1 · plan, bottom dimension string
evidence.note: 181 cm is the overall plan depth of the L from the back of B to the end of A; B nominal carcass depth 60 cm.

evidence.source: Furniture drawing, PDF page 1 · plan, A interior and B elevations
evidence.note: A return width is 114 cm in plan, 116 cm in elevation with separate 7 cm strip. B exterior/interior subdivisions also vary by up to several cm. Draft follows outer elevation for B and plan for A; confirm or accept as schematic. A carcass depth (600 mm) is provisional. Second preview aligns the closed fronts, transition trim and return wardrobe shelf order to the elevations without changing the approved envelope. Updated pass closes the L-corner return void, vanity niche perimeter reveals, and closed-facade seams to uniform 3 mm reveals.

evidence.source: Furniture drawing, PDF page 1 · A interior and exterior
evidence.note: Double short hanging, shelves, four depicted internal drawer fronts, matte cashmere doors and vertical pulls. A uses a 2700 mm envelope and 60 mm plinth for preview.

evidence.source: Furniture drawing, PDF page 1 · B interior/exterior
evidence.note: Dead corner, mixed-height hanging, shelves, internal drawers, mini fridge and an existing post; shown with approximate panel positions on the chosen frontage.

evidence.source: Furniture drawing, PDF page 1 · elevations and detail notes
evidence.note: Panel thickness, depth of many internals, door pivot hands/travel, slider travel and exact rail/pull locations are illustrative. Finishes use the named drawing materials with approximate colors/textures; polished mirrors are represented by a metallic surface, not a room reflection. Hinge/flap pivots are aligned to the front outer leaf edges with corner-door restrictor angles and hinge-side drawer clearances for collision-free motion. Door opening angles are set to maximum unobstructed swing around each front-outer-corner hinge axis.

evidence.source: Furniture drawing, PDF page 1 · B exterior and material notes
evidence.note: 55 cm niche, 10 cm mirror storage, recessed integrated Dekton Khalo basin, bronze tap and 18 mm walnut flap on bottom hinges; approximate basin shape, plumbing and real wall conditions not modeled.

evidence.source: Furniture drawing, PDF page 1 · B exterior LED detail
evidence.note: Two vertical LED channels flank the mirror; detail indicates 12×8 mm grooves and 122–272 cm levels. Light source is recessed inside the vanity alcove behind the flanking stiles, and control location/intensity are for visual demonstration only.

evidence.source: Furniture drawing, PDF page 1 · bottom-left drawing notes; user sign-off
evidence.note: The drawing calls for a pull-down mechanism. The user approved showing the rail statically in this preview; linkage, travel, and operating clearance are not represented.

evidence.source: Furniture drawing, PDF page 1 · plan and site coordination notes
evidence.note: Existing post is shown as a schematic keep-clear volume. Verify actual post position, lowering and spotlights on site; room shell and ceiling fixtures are not modeled. Right-bay back, plinth, base, top, and shelves are cleanly notched around the keep-clear volume with zero mesh overlap or Z-fighting.
